about: #114: the hopscotch of a child of K at night: a tap on the child, a press, throws with a tap (the miss says why, the turn of another child in view, the demonstration of a throw after two misses), then a hold to the called square, and hops square by square with taps.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

hold.until: (() => { const v = tre.activeVillage; const s = v.state(); const a = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'folk:aim'); const c = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'folk:court').folkCourt.squares[v.session.folk()?.call]; return Boolean(a && !a.hidden && c && Math.hypot(a.position.x - c.x, a.position.z - c.z) < 0.5); })()

steps.if: tre.activeVillage.session.folk()?.phase === 'throw'

steps.print: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.jump-btn'); if (!window.__taps) { window.__taps = []; b.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { window.__down = e.timeStamp; }); b.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => { window.__taps.push(Math.round(e.timeStamp - window.__down)); }); } return 'listening'; })()
